name: Airbus A220-300
short_description: Ultra-efficient small narrow-body airliner designed for regional and short-haul transcontinental routes.
description: Originally developed as the Bombardier CSeries, the A220-300 features 5-abreast seating, extra-large windows, and GTF engines delivering 25% lower fuel burn per seat compared to previous generation aircraft.

name: Airbus A320neo
short_description: The world's best-selling single-aisle commercial jetliner family.
description: The A320neo (New Engine Option) incorporates modern Sharklet wingtip devices and fuel-efficient engines that reduce fuel burn by 20% and significantly reduce engine noise footprint.

name: Airbus A321XLR
short_description: Extra-long-range narrow-body capable of flying non-stop transatlantic routes.
description: The A321XLR unlocks new point-to-point long-haul routes (like London to Miami) by introducing a permanent Rear Center Tank (RCT) for unprecedented narrow-body fuel capacity.

name: Airbus A330-900neo
short_description: Modern re-engined wide-body known for versatile medium-to-long range operations.
description: Building on the successful A330 baseline, the A330-900neo adds high-span A350-inspired wings, new Rolls-Royce Trent 7000 engines, and the ultra-quiet Airspace cabin interior.

name: Airbus A350-900
short_description: Advanced long-range composite wide-body airliner featuring signature curved winglets.
description: Over 50% of the A350's airframe is made of carbon-fiber composite materials. Combined with aerodynamic morphing wings, it sets high standards for long-haul operating efficiency.

name: Airbus A350-1000
short_description: Airbus's largest twin-engine flagship wide-body airliner with six-wheel landing gear.
description: The stretched variant of the A350 family designed to challenge large twin-engine jets, featuring a modified wing trailing-edge and higher thrust Trent XWB-97 engines.

name: Airbus A380-800
short_description: The world's largest commercial passenger jet with a full double-deck cabin.
description: The Superjumbo is the only full-length double-decker passenger aircraft ever built. Designed for high-density global hub-to-hub routes, offering unmatched space and luxury amenities like onboard showers and bars.
